parsed.explanation: Combined regime: federal entry, passport-binary, federal-facility and custody rules create universal document/facility exposure and a discrepancy-to-refusal/fraud chain that the state's sanctuary care shield cannot cancel. The state shield for travelling families seeking youth care, identity-based prison housing dated to 2021, and active court challenges mitigate, but federal custody abuse, permanent-ineligibility risk, and documented hostility in the largest city keep this well below protective-tier scores. No execution or imprisonment for mere presence is documented.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary passport rule; X/new mismatched markers stopped, existing X valid to expiry; 2025 cable: document discrepancy causing reasonable doubt must be refused and wilful misrepresentation may support permanent fraud ineligibility. Passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements, is never automatic, limited waivers exist; ACLU suit challenges passport policy.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport marker mismatch at entry can trigger refusal/fraud inquiry, then federal detention/custody exposure despite state protections; no documented pre-emption or immunity for visitors.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections from 2026 adopted conversion model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric drugs; immigration custody reports for trans men: forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: State prison identity-based general-population housing and funded surgery documented 2015-Jan 2021; whether still in force unresolved after 2021.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry/facility arrest can move visitor into federal immigration or prison custody where birth-sex/forced-treatment practices override state identity-based housing; state prison policy does not govern federal custody.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with gender identity. Nationally 21+ state/provinces have mapped bans; 4 make use criminal in circumstances, e.g. trespass after refusal to depart, with a documented arrest and 24h in men's ward elsewhere.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 state/provinces, 4 units and capital district have no ban in mapped categories; no division-specific facility law documented. Not documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Even if state allows access, federal buildings, court, transport and other federal facilities remain birth-sex based; state law does not cancel federal facility exposure.

care_services.exposure: Federal orders label youth gender care mutilation, proposed rules would bar public reimbursement under 18, DOJ subpoenaed hospitals; several orders blocked/enjoined, status unresolved.
care_services.protection: State sanctuary law Sep 2022: first state to shield families from child-abuse investigation/prosecution for seeking youth gender care, including travelling families; hormones/puberty blockers available to outside youth.
care_services.interaction: State shield protects care-seeking in state, but federal funding, investigation and travel/entry risks remain; minor care can become federal investigative subject despite state sanctuary.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal binary definition, removal of gender-identity materials/policies, counterterrorism language prioritising 'radically pro-transgender' groups, 66% poll support for assigned-sex documents. State threat-framing not documented for this division.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment ruling and hate-crime statute; 22 state/provinces plus capital district outlaw gender-identity discrimination, but only 23 cover GI in state bias statutes.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Federal framing increases outing/search and discretionary enforcement risk at federal checkpoints; state sanctuary does not rebut federal categorisation.

minors_guardians.exposure: Federal order directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition; youth care bans in 27 state/provinces nationally and proposed federal reimbursement bar.
minors_guardians.protection: Documented state sanctuary specifically shields travelling families from investigation/prosecution and permits hormones/puberty blockers for outside youth.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor gains operative state shield for care, but federal funding/investigation orders and entry document rules for minor remain uncertain and unresolved in court.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State recorded 198 anti-LGBTQ incidents in 2025, highest raw count nationally, and largest city saw dramatic increase in anti-LGBTQ hate-crime reports while governor platformed anti-trans figures; no per-capita denominator.
street_violence_police_response.protection: July 2026 analysis places state in top-tier protective-law band with low recorded count, methodology unstated; national hate-crime statute exists.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Raw count cannot establish per-capita visitor risk, but documented increase and official platforming coexist with protections, indicating recourse may be uneven in largest city.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit, challenges to 2025 orders and proposed health rules unresolved; several orders blocked/enjoined; federal custody abuse documented without shown remedy; prison housing status after Jan 2021 unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined some orders; legal-aid FAQ on documents; state sanctuary shield is operative for care-seeking families.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies exist but timing/status at travel determines exposure; litigation does not guarantee relief during entry, facility use, detention or urgent care.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.35-A? No, higher: entry exclusion there is routine with almost never granted appeals and no remedy; here fraud bar is not automatic, courts actively litigate, state care shield operates, and imprisonment/execution for presence is not credible.

Similar to 0.55-B: extended secondary screening for document divergence, discretionary refused admission, slow rarely revised remedies, humiliation and cost without certain detention or execution. Federal facility/custody rules make this case somewhat worse, sanctuary care better.

Lower than 0.75-C: there entry on matching passport, brief detention, tribunal compensation and respectful training; here X/mismatched documents trigger refusal and possible permanent bar, federal facilities are birth-sex based, and federal custody abuse is documented.

parsed.synthesis: Final operative interaction dominates: a document discrepancy can become refusal, fraud inquiry and federal custody, while federal facilities and proposed youth-care funding rules apply regardless of state sanctuary. The sanctuary shield is a real operative protection for adults accompanying minors seeking care, and courts provide active but unresolved challenges. That combination places the visitor above routine-exclusion 0.35 tier, similar to administrative-screening/ward-by-marker 0.55 tier, below 0.65 where remedies reliably work, and well below 0.75 where entry/facilities are identity-congruent.
